name: Dotfiles Sync
description: Syncs local Git, SSH, GPG, and npm config files into the devcontainer. Works on macOS, Linux, Windows (WSL), and GitHub Codespaces. Merges instead of overwriting — safe to use alongside Codespaces native auth.

username.description: Username in the container that should receive synchronized local config files

gitconfigPath.description: Override path to .gitconfig on the host (default: auto-detected from HOME / USERPROFILE)

sshPath.description: Override path to .ssh directory on the host (default: auto-detected)

gnupgPath.description: Override path to .gnupg directory on the host (default: auto-detected)

npmrcPath.description: Override path to .npmrc on the host (default: auto-detected)
